jobs.title: Hardware Engineer Intern
jobs.content: <p>Join our FPGA team for a 10-week internship in Summer 2027.</p><h3>What you bring</h3><ul><li>You are a Bachelor's or Master's student in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or Physics</li><li>Experience with Verilog or VHDL and Python</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>C++</li></ul><p>We offer a competitive salary and housing support.</p><p>Application deadline: 15 December 2026.</p><p>Candidates must be eligible to work in the Netherlands; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for internships.</p>

jobs.title: Deep Learning Research Intern - Summer 2027
